d: It was cold outside and people needed to dance. What we brought them was something new, an experiment and a concept that was different. Here is another excerpt from our concert on the 23rd at the Shillong Choir Festival. It's the 'Christmas Medley Experiment' featuring the Shillong Chamber Choir, DJ Larry and Sound Designer Dauni. With just two days to work on this track, we put together whatever we could; but at the same time, we feel we've stumbled onto a collaboration that has a lot of creative potential. Expect more :).
